source_notes: Conventions: epochs 1-7 = 1950-59/60-69/70-79/80-89/90-2004/2005-15/2016-. entered_service decides the slot; a null entry with a note starting 'inherits:' means the earlier system continues unchanged (the sim's ladder inherits), a note starting 'never fielded'/'gap'/'shared' means real absence, which is data. Ships: dims_m len/width/height = length overall / beam / draught; speed_kmh converted from knots; mass_t = full-load displacement (submarines: submerged). Aircraft: mass_t = MTOW; road_range_km = ferry or combat range as noted in basis. Nuclear vessels: road_range_km null (endurance limited by stores). Written from recall without web access 2026-08-26; every shaky figure is in estimated_fields and per-entry confidence. French identity per docs/08: independent kit in every role from epoch 2 on, integrated self-protection EW (SPECTRA), the only Western autoloader MBT (Leclerc), organic AEW (E-3F + carrier E-2C), nuclear carrier and all-nuclear submarine force from 2001, Exocet family on ships/aircraft/submarines but never as a domestic coastal battery. | 2026-08 normalization: measurement conventions per data/factions/CONVENTIONS.md (aircraft mass=MTOW; combat-aircraft range=combat radius with attested ferry kept in ferry_range_km; support-aircraft range=max unrefuelled range; helicopter len=fuselage with rotor_diameter_m separate and width=max airframe width; tank len=gun-forward; ship and submarine height=draught; submarine mass=submerged displacement; towed pieces carry null road range). Epoch boundaries follow the fielded-in-numbers policy (a system entering in the last ~year of an epoch sits where it was fielded in numbers); converted fields carry '| conv 2026-08' or '| audit 2026-08' notes in basis.
